decisions.challenge_policy: i+1/i+2 adjust lexical support, syntactic load and task complexity within the selected course; never automatically advance a whole CEFR level.
decisions.override_policy: An explicit teacher level in an activity prompt overrides the course default for that activity only.
decisions.translation_policy: Teacher materials, posts, prompts, options, vocabulary and sentence-pattern scaffolds remain in the target language. Translate only interface labels and non-assessment explanatory support on student request.
decisions.phonology_policy: Use intelligibility, word stress, sentence stress and connected speech as teaching targets. Accent choice is independent of proficiency; do not penalise an intelligible accepted variety.
decisions.annotation_policy: Phonics and IPA are optional English teaching support, not Chinese pinyin/zhuyin. IPA dialect/transcription must match the selected model voice.

frameworks.label: 各級學校
frameworks.notes: 學段與 CEFR 不作固定換算。國小一、二年級及大學沒有本課綱的統一年級能力表，不虛構官方標準；教師可用 CEFR 自訂。技高採獨立課綱。

frameworks.label: 一般英語能力 CEFR
frameworks.notes: 能力描述涵蓋接收、產出、互動與中介；不是英語專屬詞彙或文法清單。

frameworks.label: 全民英檢 GEPT
frameworks.notes: 採目前官方列出的四級；聽讀與說寫分項對照。已找到2024年修訂的初、中、中高級官方參考字表；尚未匯入或確認重散布條件，高級不補造詞表。

frameworks.label: 多益 TOEIC
frameworks.notes: Listening and Reading 及 Speaking and Writing 各自選目標；證書顏色不是 CEFR 等級。不得將 LingoAct AI 分數標示為官方 TOEIC 分數。

school_stages.label: 國小三、四年級
school_stages.focus: 字母、字音連結、簡易生活用語及口語互動

school_stages.label: 國小五、六年級
school_stages.focus: 簡易聽說讀寫；畢業口語應用至少300字詞，書寫至少180字詞

school_stages.label: 國中
school_stages.focus: 日常溝通、基本句構、閱讀理解；畢業至少1200字詞，2000字參考表供延伸

school_stages.label: 普通高中
school_stages.focus: 較長文本、觀點表達、篇章組織及跨文化理解；課綱優先常用4500字，另參考大考中心六級詞彙表

school_stages.label: 技術型高中
school_stages.focus: 日常生活與職場溝通，依群科與職業情境選材
